text: Experts believe the future of artificial intelligence will bring major changes. Today we have "narrow" AI, which can only do specific tasks, like translating languages or driving cars. But many companies are now working on artificial general intelligence, or AGI — a machine that can think and learn like a human. Supporters say AGI could help solve big problems, such as disease and climate change. However, critics warn about serious risks, including lost jobs and safety issues. Some experts predict AGI may arrive within twenty years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, but the debate is growing every day.
